title: receipt evidence record
description: The record written by receipt/evidence.py:write() to receipts/<timestamp>-<random>.json. schema_version bumps only on a breaking change (a field renamed or removed) -- a new field being added is not breaking and does not bump it.

sha256.description: sha256 hex digest of `receipt`, serialized as json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str) -- recompute the same way to verify the record wasn't edited after being written.

written_at.description: Unix timestamp (time.time()) of when this record was written.

task.description: The --task value: what the command was asked to do, in the caller's own words.

command.description: The argv the command was run with, redacted (receipt/redact.py) -- secret-shaped substrings are replaced with [REDACTED].

exit_code.description: null only when the command never launched at all (see status/detail).

declared_paths.description: null means no scope was declared for this run (status is then always unverified). Entries may be exact relative paths or fnmatch glob patterns.

renamed.description: A removed path and an added path sharing an identical content hash, paired instead of reported as an unrelated delete + create.

mode_changed.description: Paths whose permission bits changed with byte-identical content. A file whose content also changed appears in `modified`, not here.

unexpected.description: Touched paths not covered by declared_paths -- always [] when status is pass or unverified.

status.description: pass: touched only what was declared. fail: touched something outside the declared scope, or the command never launched. unverified: no scope was declared for this run -- a legitimate audit-logging mode, not a degraded result.

detail.description: Human-readable summary of the verdict; the only field with launch-failure detail ("could not launch the command: ...") when exit_code is null.
